review.method: Visual review with local Whisper transcript support

steps.title: Prepare the materials
steps.instruction: Prepare the template, scissors, coloring tools, and a glue stick.

steps.title: Decorate the template
steps.instruction: Draw the face and other details on the flat template.

steps.title: Cut the solid lines
steps.instruction: Cut around the template and arms along the solid lines.

steps.title: Fold the dotted lines
steps.instruction: Fold the template along each dotted line.

steps.title: Glue the body
steps.instruction: Put glue on the tabs and press the body into shape.

steps.title: Add arms and accessories
steps.instruction: Attach the arms and add accessories made from scrap paper.
